title: GIVE IT TO GOD: Stop Worrying And Trust God (Christian Motivation)
paragraphs: in the midst of life's ups and downs there's a reassuring truth that I want you to remember amidst the trials you don't have to bear the weight of your worries alone give it to God stop worrying trust God I am also going to pray a powerful prayer with you in the mighty name of Jesus so watch until the end and open your heart to receive the blessings of this prayer now have you ever let your imagination run wild when you felt

a little off let me tell you a little story about a man named Mike so Mike started getting really worried when his heart began to beat faster after having a cup of morning coffee this happened to Mike three days in a row and so he thought it was a sign of a major heart issue so of course just like some of us who googles every little ache and pain my Googled heart diseases by now he was fully convinced that he had

major heart issues overwhelmed with fear and worry Mike finally went to see the doctor after listening to his concerns and doing a few health checks the doctor chuckled and said Mike that's just caffeine doing its thing your heart's all good Mike turned a bit red izing he had turned a caffeine buzz into a huge heart scare this funny story taught him that sometimes a calm perspective and a bit of knowledge can help you avoid big worries over small Sensations are you

feeling a bit like Mike today don't allow worry to take the driver's seat of your thoughts steering you into the confusing Maze of anxiety worry has the potential to not only burden you mentally but also to take a toll on you physically financially and spiritually among other ways but let me assure you there's a way out of this cycle of worry a path that leads to peace and Trust so today we will look at the transformative power of surrendering our worries

to God and embracing the unshakable foundation of trust in him worry my friends is a burden that we often bear a weight that pulls us down in so many ways in Matthew 6 verse 27. Jesus questioned the whole sense of worry asking which of You by worrying can add one cubit to his stature the truth is worry doesn't alter the course of events despite all our worrying the challenges or trials still remain in fact worry doesn't change anything it only nibbles

away at our peace and distances us from the joyous life that God desires for us so Jesus is saying to you what's the point of worrying can worrying even change a single thing as we go about each day let us remember that there's one who is willing and able to carry our burdens to turn our anxieties into peace and our fears into Faith so let go of those heavy worries that have been tugging at your heart and embrace the Divine invitation

to entrust them to the one who holds the universe in his hands starting right now let us choose to give our worries to God and put all our trust in his perfect plan as we navigate the path between trust and worry we often feel tempted to control everything right but consider that surrendering control as the Book of Proverbs wisely States is not a sign of weakness but a demonstration of profound wisdom proverbs 3. verses 5 to 6 urges us to trust

in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding in all your ways acknowledge Him and he shall direct your paths our journey of trust mirrors the faith of Abraham who obediently followed God's lead to an unfamiliar land leaving behind the comfort of his homeland friends God's plans often defy our logic but his purpose is eternally sound just as Abraham's Faith opened the doors to the promised land our trust in God unlocks the Treasure Trove of his

Abundant Blessings Psalm 37 verse 5 tells us commit your way to the Lord trust also in him and he shall bring it to pass his promise in this psalm Echoes Through Time reassuring us that when we commit our ways to the Lord he fulfills his promises in a world full of uncertainties the steady rhythm of God's faithfulness runs through our lives like a steady stream Imagine David a young Shepherd standing before the huge giant Goliath armed only with a sling and

Stones his trust in God was unshakable as we look back on stories from long ago we find ourselves on the shores of the Red Sea with Israel a nation once trapped in slavery in the desert God sent down food from the sky and water from a rock showing how much he cares the words of Psalm 37 verse 25 echo in our hearts and it says I have been young and now I'm old yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken nor

his descendants begging bread this verse stands as proof of a faithful God who takes care of his children no matter the situation now the principle of putting God's kingdom first shapes our faith Journey Jesus himself urged us to make seeking his kingdom our top priority promising that he would take care of our needs the story of Mary and Martha helps us see what matters most Mary chose to sit and listen to Jesus showing that his presence was more important than anything

else around the words of Matthew 6. verse 33 says but seek first the kingdom of God and his righteousness and all these things shall be added to you this verse is assuring us that when we focus on God's Kingdom everything else falls into place worries lose their grip as we look to the one who inspires our faith then amid life's stormy seas the peace that transcends human understanding becomes our anger in Philippians 4 verses 6 to 7. the Apostle Paul tells

us this be anxious for nothing but in everything by prayer and supplication with Thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God and the peace of God which surpasses all understanding will guard your hearts and Minds through Christ Jesus this peace isn't just a passing feeling it's a robust and Constant Comfort that stands guard over our hearts and minds and the Embrace of Christ's presence reflect on those times when life through its challenges at you and yet there was a calm

Assurance within just as a ship navigate Stormy Waters with a solid anchor our faith in God's unchanging love offers us this unwavering peace amid the trials and challenges of life it remains unshakable this piece is like a calming hand on our shoulders Whispering that we're not alone it's a gentle reminder that even when circumstances churn around us God steadying presence is our anchor it extends an open invitation urging us to release our worries into the capable hands of the Prince of

Peace who holds the power to transform our anxieties into calm and serenity consider this releasing worry and embracing God's peace requires a conscious Choice first Peter 5 7 implores us to cast all your care upon him for he cares for you imagine a ship's Captain unloading his cargo trusting the harbor to provide Refuge similarly when we cast our anxieties unto God we entrust him with our concerns acknowledging that his care surpasses our own understanding this practice is a testament to our

faith much like the Widow who gave her last two mites trusting God's provision beyond measure so ask yourself are you trusting God today are you casting your cares upon Him Now walking by faith is another important aspect of our worry-free journey it's like venturing through a dense forest we can't see the path ahead but we rely on the invisible guide who leads us forward just as a hiker depends on their Compass to navigate the thick Woods our trust in the Unseen

hand of God gives us Direction this is similar to how Noah obediently built an ark in preparation for a flood he hadn't yet witnessed we are called to step forward in faith Hebrews 11 verse 1 tells us now Faith is the substance of things hoped for the evidence of things not seen this Faith propels us beyond what we can see encouraging us to walk confidently on the Uncharted Road of the unfamiliar just like Moses who fearlessly guided God's people through the

parted Red Sea our faith journey is like stepping into the extraordinary with unshakable trust Moses showed us what it means to believe in a God who breaks through human limits and takes us places we can't even imagine just as Moses led the way through Waters that parted we too can follow our faith even when the path seems uncertain like Moses we're not alone in this journey we have a God who leads us with a loving hand guiding us through moments that

challenge our understanding these moments draw us closer to him when we explore how even unlikely people like Rahab the Harlot are praised for their faith we uncover a glimpse of God's mercy and love along with his mysterious ways of working rahab's story gives us yet another reason as to why we shouldn't judge others you see While others might have overlooked her God saw straight into rahab's heart Discerning a faith that transcended her circumstances so Rahab was an unexpected hero in the

tale of Jericho who displayed her faith by Sheltering Israelite spies Hebrews 11 verse 6. reminds us but without faith it is impossible to please him for he who comes to God must believe that he is and that he is a rewarder of those who diligently seek Him Our Journey of Faith is more than just personal experience it becomes a story that impacts others around us our faith transforms into a Guiding Light showing the way for others just as rahab's Faith led

her to safety our trust in God's control acts as a beacon helping those who are lost in the confusion of life's waves then in the midst of life's bustling worries we must remember the words of Jesus in Luke 12 25. and which of You by worrying can add one cubit to his stature so as I've said before in some of my previous videos worry and doubt are like thieves that robs us of our peace a Relentless burden that only weighs us

down but when we recognize God's care and let go of our worries it changes the focus of our perspective just like Joseph went from a pit to a palace with God's help where also in his Caring Hands and his love is bigger than our worries building spiritual resilience through challenges is also a vital aspect of our faith Journey picture job who faced unimaginable suffering yet clung to his trust in God's sovereignty James 1 verses 3 to 4 says knowing that the

testing of your faith produces patience but let patience have its perfect work that you may be perfect and complete lacking nothing just as a Sculptor Hammers and chisels away at the Raw Stone to reveal a masterpiece so does God use challenges to shape us into vessels of endurance our Faith's resilience like that of job is a testament to The God Who sustains us through life storms amid life's demands it's easy to overlook the treasures of gratitude often it's not about needing

more to be thankful for it's about becoming more thankful in general this shift in perspective cultivates a heart that's shielded against the arrows of worry consider the Samaritan leper healed by Jesus who chose to return and Express gratitude it's a simple act with profound implications in the book of Philippians 4 verse 6 we're urged don't be anxious about anything instead in every situation through prayer and petition with Thanksgiving tell your requests to God this is why gratitude emerges as a potent

Force because it is capable of breaking through worries Shadow it serves as a constant reminder of the countless blessings lavished upon us by our heavenly father much like the psalmist who offered praise even in times of trial we too can express our gratitude amid our concerns no matter how bad the situation may appear there is always something to be thankful for embracing Divine timing marks the Pinnacle of Our Journey of Faith reflect upon the story of Esther who was uniquely positioned

to save her people from destruction Ecclesiastes 3 verse 11 declares he has made everything beautiful in its time just as Esther's purpose unfolded at the perfect time so does ours Our Lives intricately woven by the hands of the Creator are orchestrated according to his Divine timetable just as Joseph's dreams were realized in God's appointed hour we are invited to embrace the beauty of God's timing embracing God's timing is the Pinnacle of our journey to let go of our worries trusting God's

timing gives rise to the moment when everything falls into place according to God's perfect plan think about Esther an ordinary woman chosen to play an extraordinary role in Saving her people from impending disaster take another look at Joseph whose dreams and Destiny aligned at the precise moment that God ordained just as Joseph patiently waited and put his trust in God we too are encouraged to welcome the Deep Beauty of God's timing in our own Journeys just like a well-arranged melody where

every note falls into place our lives are directed by the master composer who orchestrates each component at just the right time so my dear friends when we stand at the crossroads of trust and worry let us remember that worry is a burden that we were never meant to carry like a child running into the loving arms of a parent let us cast our worries upon the one who cares for us deeply surrender control just as Abraham did and find security in

God's Sovereign plans I encourage you to reflect on God's faithfulness seek his kingdom Above All Else and rest in the peace that surpasses understanding cast your cares upon Him daily walk in faith and become beacons of trust for others recognize God's care build resilience cultivate gratitude and embrace Divine timing as we navigate life's complex Journey may we find comfort in the arms of our faithful father releasing our worries and embracing his unwavering love it doesn't matter what you're worried about remember

worrying won't change anything give it to God put your trust in the one who holds tomorrow now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to our gracious and loving God dear heavenly father you are the first and the last you are the beginning and the ending I am grateful that

you are my comforter and Redeemer Lord I come before you humbly With My Heart full of Thanksgiving and praise as I come before you I cast all my worries cares and anxieties upon you because you care for me Lord I Thank You For Life I thank you for your grace love and mercy towards me and others I am grateful for all that you have done for me and for all that you are about to do in my life Lord you are

my eternal Rock I am grateful that you will keep me in perfect peace because I trust in you in the name of Jesus I declare that worry has no hold over me I Break Every Chain of fear and anxiety knowing that your perfect love casts out all fear Lord I declare your promises over my life and over the lives of my loved ones believing that your plans for us are good and filled with hope in the name of Jesus I rebuke

every negative thought that tries to steal my peace and I replace them with the truth of your word I declare that I am protected by your Mighty hand and that no weapon formed against me shall prosper in the name of Jesus I Break Every curse negativity stagnation and stronghold over my life and I declare that I am covered by the blood of Jesus and no harm shall come near me my loved ones or my home father I declare your authority over

all sickness and disease by the stripes of Jesus I am healed and I stand on the Promises of your word I rebuke every trace of illness every symptom and every negative report that seeks to contradict your truth in the name of Jesus I declare release from pain discomfort and all physical and mental distress I thank you for your promise that you are near the Brokenhearted to those who are depressed and that you heal those who are crushed in spirit I believe

in your healing power and I declare restoration and wholeness over my entire being in the name of Jesus I stand in agreement for Abundant Blessings to overflow in my life as your word promises that you are able to do exceedingly and abundantly above all that we can ask or think Lord as I say this prayer together with everyone listening I thank you for all the hearts that are humbled before you right now I pray that those who are worried will find

comfort in your presence that those who are seeking control will surrender to your sovereignty and that those who are burdened by the weight of their concerns will find rest in your care in the name of Jesus we pray for the strength to face challenges with unwavering faith we stand in agreement and we declare that worry has no place in our lives for we have a God who is greater than our worries and who holds every moment in his hands Lord we

hand over our worries to you we trust in your timing your provision and your unchanging love may Our Lives be living testimonies of your faithfulness as we walk in the freedom that comes from placing our trust in you Lord we thank you for the peace joy and unwavering faith that you provide father we thank you that your goodness and mercy will follow us all the Days of Our Lives thank you Lord for hearing and answering my prayer in the name of

Jesus I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comment section below I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus you can help us to reach more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member who you know needs the blessing of this prayer and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the

channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all those who support us you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comments section so that we can present them before God for your blessings and victory also we invite other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you right now and we want you to know that even if you

don't see a reply to your prayer request it doesn't mean that you were not prayed for rest assured that we are actively lifting up each request to God that is in accordance with his will we believe in the power of Prayer to bring Comfort healing and guidance in accordance with God's perfect plan stand in faith with us while we pray to God be all the glory May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all foreign
